title: Hasina Supporters Vandalise BNP Office In Bangladesh's Gopalganj Amid Fresh Violence
text:
Fresh political violence has erupted in Bangladesh as supporters of former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina intensify protests against the government. A Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) office was vandalised in Gopalganj, while the ancestral home of former interim leader Muhammad Yunus was set on fire in Chattogram.

The unrest comes amid an Awami League campaign demanding Hasina's return from exile in India. The violence has also prompted heightened security deployments across several districts.

title: Meta says 'reevaluating' 2030 net zero target amid AI buildout
text: Meta said Thursday it was reconsidering its 2030 deadline for net zero emissions because of the artificial intelligence boom, the latest in a broad retreat by corporations on global warming targets. The reality has been far more complex," the executives wrote, adding that delivering on Meta's vision "requires building the infrastructure that powers AI."
